correctness.rationale: All 28 geometric theta-contact lines are explicitly listed as 12 coordinate-pair fourth-root lines and 16 three-coordinate fourth-root lines. The polynomial square identity is verified; genus-three theta theory gives the exhaustive count. For q≡1 mod4, arithmetic Frobenius acts by known fourth-power residue shifts and the exact 16-case table follows; for q≡3 mod4 quadratic characters show exactly four rational lines and all fourth roots in Fq², hence 1^4 2^12. Standard finite étale orbit counting proves the extension and zeta formulas. Independent exact projective-line binary-square tests over eleven odd prime fields and F9 agree; they are not treated as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The geometric 12+16 lines, Fermat automorphism G-set and genus-three twist classification are established literature, and not new. The inspected primary papers and database did not state the full coefficient-class Frobenius cycle decomposition of the 28-point bitangent scheme for all odd q, including the universal q≡3 (mod4) quadratic-splitting type. Targeted published-record searches found no identical arithmetic bitangent classification. This is a qualified self-review originality assessment with residual risk that historical Galois-theta formulations or combined classical computations already imply the table.
residual_risks: The 12+16 geometric bitangent formulas and Fermat geometric group actions are classical; a different historical Galois-theta treatment could contain an equivalent finite-field arithmetic classification.
Known finite-field automorphism and twist data may imply the cycle table by a short computation despite not explicitly stating it.
The small-field database includes concrete instances; its entire collection was not exhaustively screened for every diagonal coefficient type.

value.rationale: The 28-point odd-theta/bitangent scheme is a canonical genus-three arithmetic invariant. The classification gives the complete finite étale algebra Frobenius splitting, all minimal definition degrees, extension counts and zeta functions for the natural full family of diagonal plane-quartic twists. The unexpected coefficient-independent 4-rational-bitangent phenomenon in q≡3 mod4 is a structural finite-field descent fact; this is not an unmotivated isolated computation.
